title: Jia2019: Motor-imagery EEG dataset for stroke patients (Jia 2019)
description: EEG recordings from 15 stroke patients performing cue-based left-hand versus right-hand motor imagery, with 40 trials per class. Data were acquired from 63 channels (10-10 system) at 512 Hz in two runs per patient, and are preprocessed and epoched. This BIDS re-release was produced with MOABB for brain-computer interface research and neurorehabilitation.
methods_description: Cue-based motor imagery paradigm in which each stroke patient imagined left- and right-hand movements (one hand paretic, the other unaffected). EEG was recorded from 63 channels at 512 Hz with 50 Hz line frequency, in 2 runs for one session per subject, with trials spanning 0 to 6.8 s.
